1.name: Linux SNMP
1.intro: Monitors Linux servers through SNMP: CPU, memory and swap, load, disk I/O, storage and inode usage, interfaces, TCP and UDP connections, processes, ARP, NTP and uptime.

2.name: Linux SSH
2.intro: Monitors Linux servers over SSH: CPU, memory and swap, load, disk I/O, mountpoints and LVM, network traffic, systemd services and journal, files, quotas, pending updates and uptime.

3.name: Apache Webserver
3.intro: Monitors Apache web servers through the HTTP status page: CPU usage, requests, response time, worker slot states and the number of workers.

4.name: Elasticsearch
4.intro: Monitors Elasticsearch through its REST API: cluster, node and index statistics, shard states, the license and the results of custom queries.

5.name: MariaDB/MySQL
5.intro: Monitors MariaDB and MySQL servers through SQL queries: connection time, database sizes, buffer and cache hit rates, queries, threads, open files and tables, replication, backups and uptime.

6.name: PHP-FPM
6.intro: Monitors PHP-FPM pools: active and idle processes, the listen queue and the requests per second.

7.name: SSL certificates - x509
7.intro: Monitors the validity of x509 SSL/TLS certificates: HTTPS, SMTP, IMAP, POP3 and FTP services as well as certificate files, with the days left until expiration.

8.name: Dell iDRAC
8.intro: Monitors Dell iDRAC controllers through SNMP: the global status and the status of the server hardware components.

9.name: Netapp Ontap SNMP
9.intro: Monitors NetApp ONTAP systems through SNMP: CPU, aggregates, file systems and volumes, hardware (fans, power supplies, temperature, shelves, NVRAM), failover, SnapMirror and snapshots, quotas and CIFS/NFS activity.

10.name: i-Vertix3 Monitoring Central (legacy)
10.intro: Monitors a legacy i-Vertix3 monitoring central server: Gorgone, broker, poller delay and database partitioning, together with Apache, MariaDB, PHP-FPM, system resources and the platform processes.

11.name: i-Vertix3 Poller (legacy)

12.name: Windows SNMP

17.name: Fujitsu iRMC
